name: US National Weather Service
description: Official public US National Weather Service API for active weather alerts, alert history, point forecasts, forecast grids, observation stations, and observations. No API key is required; NWS asks clients to send an identifiable User-Agent with contact information.

credential_fields.name: contact_email
credential_fields.label: Contact email
credential_fields.description: NWS requests an identifiable User-Agent containing contact information. This is not an API credential.

tools.name: list_active_alerts
tools.description: List current NWS alerts. Narrow by state/territory area code, point, zone, urgency, severity, certainty, or event name. For storm-response leads, filter events such as Severe Thunderstorm Warning, Tornado Warning, or Severe Weather Statement.

area.description: Two-letter state or territory code, for example TX or FL.

tools.name: search_alerts
tools.description: Search recent or historical alert products with temporal and status filters. NWS does not promise a permanent complete archive through this endpoint; use NCEI archives for long-term analysis.

tools.name: get_alert
tools.description: Get one NWS alert by its identifier.

alert_id.description: Alert identifier from an alerts response.

tools.name: resolve_point
tools.description: Resolve latitude/longitude to the responsible NWS office, forecast grid coordinates, county/forecast zone, radar station, and forecast URLs. Call this before point forecasts or station lookup.

tools.name: get_forecast
tools.description: Get the standard forecast for an NWS grid point. Resolve office/grid coordinates with resolve_point first.

tools.name: list_point_stations
tools.description: List observation stations associated with a latitude/longitude point.

tools.name: get_latest_observation
tools.description: Get the latest observation from an NWS station, including wind gust and precipitation when reported.
